packs.title: Bay Stories & Shorelines
packs.promise: Explore Tampa through water, history, wildlife and working shorelines.

q.t: A Map with a Point of View
q.s: Read a map as a choice about what matters.
st: Enter the open Touchton Map Library or another current map display.
Choose one map and notice two details the maker emphasized.
Write what a visitor might miss if they used only that map.

q.s: Sketch the silhouette of a former hotel.
st: Find an open public view of Plant Hall.
Trace two roofline or minaret shapes without entering a controlled area.
Sketch the silhouette and mark the feature that most identifies it.

q.s: Sketch one design choice in an animal habitat.
st: Enter during ordinary zoo admission and choose an open animal-viewing area.
Notice one designed feature that supports an animal or gives it choice.
Sketch the feature and write what it seems to allow.

packs.title: Ybor City on Foot
packs.promise: Walk the factory blocks, social clubs and public places of Ybor City.

q.s: Read the scale of cigar production from a public corner.
st: View the old factory complex from a public corner.
Compare its length and height with a nearby smaller building.
Record one way the factory’s size hints at its former work.

q.s: Sketch an entrance to the historic commercial street.
st: Find an open sidewalk view of the archway.
Notice one shape or word that frames the avenue.
Sketch the gateway and mark what draws the eye into the street.

q.t: A House Built for Work Nearby
q.s: Read a modest residence beside an industrial neighborhood.
st: From a permitted viewpoint, choose one restored worker house.
Sketch the roofline and one human-scale detail.
Write how the house’s size contrasts with the factory buildings.
